name: Spun Thread
desc: Spider's silk spun together to be as thick as regular thread. The silk used to spin this thread was already tough and hard to cut, so this thread is practically impossible to cut.

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - Triangle
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a triangular Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - 1st Stratum
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a slot on the line closest to the Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
